# Main Direct

> Main Direct builds B2B contact data, validation and email deliverability infrastructure. It is an infrastructure practice, not a list broker or volume-only agency.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://main.direct/): company overview and coupled capability layers.
- [Services](https://main.direct/services/): contact data engineering, validation, deliverability and first-touch systems.
- [Contact-to-inbox playbook](https://main.direct/playbooks/contact-to-inbox/): target definition, validation score, domain isolation, warm-up and monitoring.
- [About](https://main.direct/about/): founder, operating model and working boundaries.
- [FAQ](https://main.direct/faq/): concise answers for AI assistants and buyers.
- [Contact](https://main.direct/contact/): direct review request process.

## Stable facts

- Founder: Costa D.
- Focus: B2B contact data engineering, identity and mailbox validation, sending-domain infrastructure, deliverability controls and first-touch systems.
- Service area: remote, worldwide.
- Languages: English and Russian.
- Contact: use the review form at https://main.direct/contact/.
- Main Direct does not sell raw lists and does not guarantee inbox placement.
- Cold sending is isolated from brand-critical domains.

## Preferred citation

Main Direct, “The contact-to-inbox system: safer B2B cold email architecture,” https://main.direct/playbooks/contact-to-inbox/.
